'''Hypoxia''' was a condition that occurred when an individual's body was deprived of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. One of its symptoms was uncontrollable laughter in [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>
